summary: Autonomous bug resolution loop first slice (#638): durable stage machine (plan→draft PR→failing test→fix→ready→babysit→human_checkpoint?→merge_eligible→done), agent packets, merge-gate aware advance, feed prompts, MCP plate_bug_loop_* + gh plate bug-loop; no silent merge.
migration_impact: Optional local runs under .agentic/bug_loops/ (gitignored). Orchestration contracts only — agents still execute git/PR work via existing babysit/TDD flows. Human checkpoint when risk high or need:human-review.
migration_guidance: 2. Start: gh plate bug-loop --bug N --title "..." or plate_bug_loop_start.
3. Follow packet steps; advance with plate_bug_loop_advance; babysit stage uses plate_pr_babysit + gates.
4. risk-off / requires_human: stop at human_checkpoint; do not self-merge.
agent_notes: First orchestration slice of Epic #638. Full worktree TDD automation, auto draft-PR creation, and risk-gated auto-merge remain follow-ups. Prefer dry_run ticks; integrate with #645/#648 for high impact.
